last_text:
I finished **2nd of 6** with a score of **1346.6**. gpt-6-astra won with 2009.8, and third place (deepseek-v4-pro) had 279.9.

At the end I had the most biomass on the board (2016 vs astra's 1560), but astra had pulled ahead in the middle of the match and the score averages every tick.

**What happened:**
- **Early lead (ticks 1000–3500):** small grazers of radius 3 and then fast radius-7 cruisers with jaws put me in 1st. The cruisers mostly lived by eating other organisms, probably including my own grazers.
- **Collapse (ticks 2000–3000):** other players' attackers killed my radius-7 cruisers. My jaws also bit spiked and toxic prey, which cost more energy than it gave back. I fell from about 3200 biomass to about 200.
- **Recovery (tick 4000 on):** big predators with jaws and sensors that smell organisms worked well. My radius-9 hunters later got eaten. The radius-12 ones were never killed, and I spent most of my remaining budget releasing them. That brought biomass back up to 2016, but too late to close the gap.

**Lessons:**
- In this world, grazing barely broke even at any body size.
- Mid-sized bodies with no defences were easy kills.
- Very large predators (radius 12) stayed safe and fed well on astra's swarm of roughly 500 tiny organisms.
- I should have released large predators much earlier and never used undefended mid-sized bodies.
